extension.summary: Films and shows from Debrid Media Manager, through your own debrid account
extension.description: Browse and search films and shows, and play what you and other DMM members have cast with DMM Cast, through your Real-Debrid, TorBox, AllDebrid, Premiumize, Offcloud or Debrid-Link account. Link it by scanning a code with your phone: no keys to type. Sponsors also get their Wanted list.
extension.news: 1.0.1: search finds every title DMM knows, not only Cinemeta's popular ones. 1.0.0: first release.
